I spoke with Larry last night. He is very interested in the job at lsj. I learned the following about Larry:
I) has has 3 kids with age 13 youngest which would would have to come with him to lsj. Other kids are 26 and I
believe 32
2) Larry wife already briefly looked into private school on stt and found a Montessori school.
3) currently Larry only works on Long Island Sunday - Thursday and spends 4 hours per day commuting as he
currently lives in Fairfield county ct
4) current salary is 133k and he received a 20k bonus
5) currently oversees 3 properties (all in the same town)
6) largest home is 45,000 which was built new
7) Larry said he oversaw the construction process and is knowledgeable with construction
8) Larry wife currently is home with kids but used to work as a private chef.
Seems like it could be a good fit. Not sure how locals will react to phillipinos as I do not recall us ever having
that combination.
Daphne and i have had multiple discussions about having management broken down as:
I) someone overseeing jee and home needs where Larry and wife can work great. With extra time Larry can
assist with other roles below..
2) construction management. Kyle can oversee projects and be assisted with Anna who can deal with locals and
possibly Stephanie who can coordinate with Daphne to keep kyle organized.
3) plant manager and electrician. Hopefully Glidden can fall into place and begin to get his hands dirty as he will
be removed from coordinating barge runs and other silly tasks such as shopping that Brice had him doing.
I land today around 2:30pm then will spend some time with Larry at the hanger.
Will coordinate to meet vendors Monday and Tuesday as well. May be best to come Monday morning to visit
islands as many of stc staff will be at Bryant ceremony.
I will be meeting with Stephanie, Karen Una Daphne Jeanne Tuesday morning at stc office.
